'''Osaji Hux''' was a member of the [[Osaji family]], who was a member of the family business, the [[Osaji Syndicate]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she disguised herself and in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Shulstine V]], hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to kill her brothers, [[Osaji Uhares]] and [[Osaji Varane]], and herself, not revealing to them her true identity. The spacers tracked her to the planet [[Muskree]], where she planned to kill them, to prevent details getting out about who ordered the deaths of her brothers. However, an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] squad that had also been tracking her arrived and this resulted in the [[Battle of Hardscrabble]], fought between the spacers, the townsfolk, the Imperials and Hux's thugs.
